text:
You need help refining an existing Prezi deck for your new SaaS product, aligning it to your branding kit, and adding a few new frames.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience, and I’ve helped build polished product experiences that communicate clearly. In a recent B2B SaaS project, I built embedded customer analytics dashboards using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, and the product rolled out to 140 customer accounts three weeks early.

For your Prezi, I can tighten the structure, bring the visuals in line with your brand, and expand the deck so it feels cohesive and presentation-ready. I’d be glad to help with future decks as well, since keeping messaging consistent across presentations is often just as important as the first one.
